name: Schema Mapping (IRCC)
tagline: Maps source fields to the canonical model · runs in Microsoft Foundry
instructions: Reads a source schema and the target canonical model, then proposes field-to-field mappings with transform hints and a mismatch report. Every mapping cites both fields, and the result is a spreadsheet for data analysts to review.
starters: Map the attached source schema to the attached canonical model
Which source fields have no canonical match?
attachHint: Attach the source schema (SQL, XSD, JSON Schema or data dictionary) and the target model with 'canonical' or 'target' in its file name.
